billing_notes: * **Batch inference** is billed at **50% of serverless pricing** on both input and output. See [Batch inference](/guides/batch-inference).
* **Cached input tokens** — input tokens served from [prompt cache](/guides/prompt-caching), priced lower.
* **Input tokens** — what you send to the model.
* **Output tokens** — what the model generates.
* Prices below are **per 1 million tokens** in US dollars.
**—** in the Priority column means Priority is not available for that model. This pricing table is the source of truth for Priority availability.
> Per-token serverless pricing for text, vision, and embedding models, including Priority and Fast serverless modes
> Use https://docs.fireworks.ai/nexus/firerouter for how model routers work, the supported model list, composition, closed-model credentials, and pricing.
Embeddings are billed only on input tokens.
Embeddings are billed per 1M input tokens.
Every text or vision request is billed across three dimensions:
For any text or vision model not listed individually, pricing is set by parameter count and architecture. These size-based prices apply uniformly to input and output (no separate cached-input rate):

Per-model pricing for headline models. Fast variants appear as adjacent rows. In each **Standard** or **Priority** cell, prices are **input / cached input / output** (USD per 1M tokens), in that order.
Serverless inference is priced per token. For how Standard, Priority, and Fast modes work and how to select one, see [Serverless Modes](/serverless/serverless-modes).

billing_notes: * **1h cache writes:** Writing a prompt prefix to the 1-hour prompt cache.
* **5m cache writes:** Writing a prompt prefix to the 5-minute prompt cache.

* **Automatic caching:** Add a single `cache_control` field at the top level of your request. The system automatically manages cache breakpoints as conversations grow. This is the recommended starting point for most use cases.
* **Bedrock** offers two endpoint types: global endpoints (dynamic routing for maximum availability) and regional endpoints (guaranteed data routing through specific geographic regions).
* **Cache hits and refreshes:** Reading a prompt prefix from the prompt cache, which also refreshes it.
* **Explicit cache breakpoints:** Place `cache_control` directly on individual content blocks for fine-grained control over exactly what gets cached.
* **MTok:** Million tokens. $5 / MTok is $5 for every million tokens.

One hundred (100) CCU represents $1.00 USD of fees owed for the Services, calculated at the applicable prices on [claude.com/pricing#api](https://claude.com/pricing#api), after application of any discounts.

billing_notes: - **Agentic video understanding:** When using agentic video understanding, token usage is variable based on the content loaded by the model rather than full video length. cells: Grounding with Google Search & Web Grounding for Enterprise

Includes 5,000 Grounding Queries per month at no charge, aggregated across all Gemini 3 models. Grounding Queries exceeding those limits are billed at $14 per 1,000 Grounding Queries . Please contact your account team if you require more than 1 million Grounding Prompts per day. A “ Grounding Prompt ” is an End User prompt that Customer submits to Gemini for which Gemini makes one or more queries to a Google web index (each a “ Grounding Query ”) . You will be charged for each individual Grounding Query performed. Billing will start January 5, 2026. Input tokens provided by Grounding with Google Search or Web Grounding for Enterprise are not charged. Customers may decide not to display Search Suggestions with Grounded Results in their Customer Applications at standard pricing for under 1 million Grounding Prompts per day.
